The '''Fletcher''' is a [[villager]] profession that sells arrows by the stack and the [[Compound Bow]]. Its job site block is the Fletching Table. Unlike the vanilla fletcher, it buys no sticks, flint or string.

== Trades ==
{{Data/Trades/Fletcher}}
All trades can be used 999 times before restocking.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fletcher/1/arrow.json}}</ref>

* At Novice level the fletcher sells 64 arrows, 64 [[Apotropaic Arrow]]s or 64 [[Nightshade Arrow]]s for 1 obol each. The two tipped arrows carry the potion contents of Healing II and Poison II respectively.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fletcher/1/apotropaic_arrow.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fletcher/1/nightshade_arrow.json}}</ref>
* At Apprentice level it sells 64 spectral arrows.
* At Journeyman level it sells a [[Compound Bow]] enchanted with Power II.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fletcher/3/compound_bow.json}}</ref>
* The fletcher has no Expert or Master trades.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fletcher/4/filler.json}}</ref>

Like every villager, a fletcher that has been traded with also buys its [[favorite food]] once.
